rows.grounds: locative of pañcagavya, the five cow products
optative of kṣip, to throw or cast
past-participle adjective mantrita in accusative feminine

items.question: What ritual action is prescribed for a garland consecrated with the Shiva mantra?
premises: the garland is consecrated with the Shiva mantra
the garland is thrown into the five cow products
the action is expressed as an optative prescription
items.inference: The verse prescribes casting a Shiva-mantra-consecrated garland into the five cow products.
uncertainties: whether kṣipet is optative prescription or narrative statement
items.plain_english: One should throw the garland, consecrated with the Shiva mantra, into the five cow products.
